affinity.notes: Monochrome stone and bronze treatment avoids an elemental effect language.

anatomy.notes: Heavy humanoid frame, horned head, claws, and symmetrical wings are immediately legible.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "fortified tank-guardian" does not semantically communicate Buttress-Court Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Seated posture and massive armor clearly communicate low mobility and high durability.

finish.notes: Stone, metal, throne ornament, and secondary statues share a polished finish.

framing.notes: Centered throne composition presents the full silhouette without harmful cropping.

identity.notes: Blind perception "enthroned gargoyle sovereign" semantically identifies gargoyles/gargoyle-stone-sovereign.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "high" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
